snippet.title: Angry Birds Star Wars II: Revenge of the Pork – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Battle through 32 new levels set on Geonosis and Mustafar in a brand new chapter – Revenge of the Pork! Plus, get ready to take the power into your own hands in 16 new Master Your Destiny levels!
